experiments.name: tail-prefix-current
experiments.harness_commit: Frozen branch-current reporting harness plus admission of tail-prefix bit 64 combinations; identical copy for both variants

plan.description: Bounded register-only tail prefixes over graduated 0b890a26a. Full returning leaves retain priority. Both variants retain forward-only leaf expansion and single-branch/literal-PC veneers at bound 32. Frozen ABBA/BAAB and measured host-validity rules.
